"""Compare a conservative cross-module declaration dependency graph."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


class Graph:
    def __init__(self,root):self.root=root;self.parsed={};self.nodes={}
    def module(self,name):
        if name in self.parsed:return self.parsed[name]
        path=self.root/Path(*name.split('.')).with_suffix('.py')
        if not path.exists():path=self.root/Path(*name.split('.'))/'__init__.py'
        if not path.exists():return {},{}
        definitions={};imports={}
        for node in ast.parse(path.read_bytes()).body:
            if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.ClassDef)):definitions[node.name]=node
            elif isinstance(node,ast.Assign):
                for target in node.targets:
                    if isinstance(target,ast.Name):definitions[target.id]=node
            elif isinstance(node,ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(node.target,ast.Name):definitions[node.target.id]=node
            elif isinstance(node,ast.ImportFrom):
                prefix=name.split('.')[:-node.level] if node.level else []
                module='.'.join(prefix+([node.module] if node.module else []))
                for alias in node.names:imports[alias.asname or alias.name]=(module,alias.name)
        self.parsed[name]=definitions,imports
        return definitions,imports
    def walk(self,module,entry):
        pending=[(module,entry)]
        while pending:
            mod,name=pending.pop();key=f'{mod}:{name}'
            if key in self.nodes:continue
            definitions,imports=self.module(mod)
            if name in imports:
                imported,entry=imports[name]
                if imported.startswith('axiom_encode.'):
                    self.nodes[key]={'import':[imported,entry]};pending.append((imported,entry))
                else:self.nodes[key]={'external_import':[imported,entry]}
                continue
            if name not in definitions:continue
            node=definitions[name]
            references=sorted({n.id for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n,ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx,ast.Load)}&(definitions.keys()|imports.keys()))
            self.nodes[key]={'ast_sha256':sha(ast.dump(node,include_attributes=False).encode()),'references':references}
            pending.extend((mod,reference) for reference in references)
        return self.nodes


def main():
    report={'proof':'Conservative global-name dependency graph; imported package declarations recurse to their exact snapshot files. Unchanged external imports share the locked interpreter/environment.'}
    for label,entry_module,entry in [('recall','axiom_encode.harness.source_completeness','authoritative_numeric_recall_text'),('extractor','axiom_encode.harness.validator_pipeline','extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text')]:
        old=Graph(HERE/'old-main-package/src').walk(entry_module,entry)
        current=Graph(HERE/'current-main-package/src').walk(entry_module,entry)
        changed=sorted(key for key in old.keys()&current.keys() if old[key]!=current[key])
        added=sorted(current.keys()-old.keys());removed=sorted(old.keys()-current.keys())
        report[label]={'old_declaration_count':len(old),'current_declaration_count':len(current),'changed':changed,'added':added,'removed':removed,'old_graph_sha256':sha(json.dumps(old,sort_keys=True).encode()),'current_graph_sha256':sha(json.dumps(current,sort_keys=True).encode())}
        print(label,json.dumps(report[label]),flush=True)
        (HERE/f'baseline-{label}-graphs.json').write_text(json.dumps({'old':old,'current':current},indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    assert report['recall']['changed']==['axiom_encode.harness.source_completeness:authoritative_numeric_recall_text']
    assert not report['recall']['added'] and not report['recall']['removed']
    assert report['extractor']['changed']==['axiom_encode.harness.validator_pipeline:_clean_source_text_for_numeric_extraction_tracked']
    assert report['extractor']['added']==[f'axiom_encode.harness.validator_pipeline:{x}' for x in ('_COLLAPSED_CURRENCY_TABLE_ROW_BOUNDARY_PATTERN','_COLLAPSED_SIZE_TABLE_ROW_PATTERN','_INLINE_TABLE_VALUE_PATTERN','_TABLE_HEADING_PREFIX_PATTERN')]
    assert not report['extractor']['removed']
    report['all_assertions_passed']=True
    (HERE/'baseline-ast-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')


if __name__ == "__main__": main()
